billing-bot: INV-2026-0610 discount $3,000; INV-2026-0615 discount $2,000.
ozzy: net deferred = 90k + 27k + 22k = 139k. Amortize over 12 months from 2026-06-01 -> 11,583.33/mo.
frank: Proposed JE JE-2026-06-220: Dr Revenue 139,000 / Cr Deferred Rev 139,000. Memo: Reclass prepaid annual Dedicated invoices misposted during pricing experiment; amortize monthly.
audit-bot: please attach one-paragraph memo describing experiment, root cause, and corrective action.
nina_c: I'll draft auditor note and add schedule to close binder.
ozzy: billing to add a guard in staging to prevent auto-post to revenue for annual prepay invoices. Filing BLG-10012.

audit-bot: ack received. Thread closed.
